story.title: Card freeze/unfreeze in mobile app with step-up authentication
story.description: Add card freeze/unfreeze controls to the mobile app through a new API gateway endpoint backed by card-service. Each card status change requires step-up authentication from authentication-service, binds the proof to the device and requested action, and exposes only masked card details. Update mobile-banking and api-gateway authorization policies together with the card control flow. PCI DSS review and security sign-off are outstanding: the prototype permits cross-device proof replay and lacks fail-closed verification evidence. These unresolved authentication defects and the missing rollback rehearsal are release blockers until the acceptance criteria have demonstrated evidence.
acceptance_criteria: A cardholder can freeze or unfreeze their own card in mobile-banking through the API gateway endpoint, and the refreshed view shows the confirmed status.
Each action requires a fresh step-up proof bound to the card, device and requested action; replay and cross-customer requests are rejected.
If authentication-service is unavailable or proof validation fails, card-service leaves the card status unchanged and denies the action.
Card control traces contain masked identifiers only; PCI DSS review, security sign-off and a rehearsed rollback are mandatory before release.

requirement.business_summary: Cardholders gain the ability to freeze or unfreeze their own card from the mobile app. Every card status change requires a fresh step-up authentication proof bound to the card, device and requested action, and only masked card details are exposed. Replay and cross-customer requests must be rejected, and if authentication is unavailable or proof validation fails the card status must remain unchanged. PCI DSS review, security sign-off and a rehearsed rollback are outstanding release blockers.
requirement.technical_summary: A new API Gateway endpoint backs card freeze/unfreeze calls from Mobile Banking into Card Service. Authentication Service must supply a fresh step-up proof bound to card, device and requested action; Card Service must fail closed (leave status unchanged, deny action) when authentication is unavailable or proof validation fails. Mobile Banking and API Gateway authorization policies are updated along with the card control flow, and card control traces must carry masked identifiers only. The current prototype permits cross-device proof replay and lacks fail-closed verification evidence; no rollback rehearsal has been performed.
affected_capabilities: PCI DSS compliance and masked trace handling
requirement.engineering_scope: Contained change: one new API Gateway endpoint plus a Mobile Banking card control screen/flow, authorization policy updates in Mobile Banking and API Gateway, and the Card Service freeze/unfreeze handling with fail-closed behaviour. Authentication Service work is limited to issuing/validating step-up proofs bound to card, device and requested action and rejecting replay and cross-customer proofs; traces must carry masked identifiers only. No database schema change is described. Open items outside the build: PCI DSS review, security sign-off and a rehearsed rollback, which the story states are mandatory before release.

tests.title: Security: ATM withdrawal declined when card is frozen via mobile app
steps: Enroll a test card in mobile banking.
Use the mobile app to freeze the card (requires step‑up authentication).
Attempt an ATM withdrawal with the card at an ATM terminal.
Observe the ATM response and system logs.
tests.expected: The ATM declines the transaction (e.g., returns ‘card blocked’ or insufficient funds), the card status in Card Service remains frozen, and the audit log records the freeze attempt with only a masked card identifier.

tests.title: Compliance: Branch portal displays only masked card details for frozen cards
steps: A branch agent logs into the branch portal.
The agent retrieves card details for a customer whose card was frozen via the mobile app.
The agent views the card information screen.
tests.expected: The card number shown is masked (e.g., only the last four digits are visible); no full PAN is exposed, satisfying PCI DSS masking requirements.

tests.title: Operational: CRM contact update does not trigger card freeze/unfreeze actions
steps: Create a customer profile with an active card.
Via the CRM API, update the customer’s contact information (e.g., phone number).
Query Card Service to confirm the card’s current status.
tests.expected: The card’s status remains unchanged (still active/unfrozen); no freeze or unfreeze operation is invoked as a side effect of the contact update.

tests.title: Security: Customer service representative cannot freeze card without step-up authentication
steps: A CSR logs into the customer service application.
The CSR attempts to invoke the card freeze action for a customer’s card without providing any step‑up proof.
Capture the HTTP response and check Card Service status.
tests.expected: The request is rejected with an authentication error (e.g., 401/403), the card status in Card Service is unchanged, and the failure is logged in Authentication Service.

tests.title: Delivery: Loan disbursement proceeds successfully despite customer's card being frozen
steps: Ensure a customer has an approved loan and a card that has been frozen via mobile app.
Trigger the loan disbursement for that loan.
Monitor the disbursement process and the customer’s account balance.
tests.expected: The loan disbursement succeeds and funds are credited to the account; the card remains frozen in Card Service, confirming that the disbursement flow is independent of the card freeze/unfreeze feature.

tests.title: Security: Notification about card status change contains only masked card identifier
steps: Perform a card freeze operation through the mobile app with valid step‑up authentication.
Capture the notification sent to the customer (push, SMS, or email).
Inspect the notification content for card data.
tests.expected: The notification includes only a masked card reference (e.g., last four digits) and does not expose the full PAN or any other sensitive card data.

tests.title: Compliance: Reporting service outputs mask card numbers in statements after freeze/unfreeze events
steps: Generate a monthly statement for an account that experienced a card freeze/unfreeze event during the statement period.
Export the statement in PDF or CSV format.
Search the output for any occurrence of the card number.
tests.expected: Any card number appearing in the statement is masked (e.g., replaced with ****1234); no full PAN is present, meeting PCI DSS compliance for reports.

tests.title: Security: Risk engine processes card freeze/unfreeze events using only masked card data
steps: Simulate a card freeze/unfreeze event in Card Service.
Feed the event into the Risk Engine for scoring.
Examine the data received by the Risk Engine (via logs or internal metrics).
tests.expected: The Risk Engine receives only a tokenized or masked card identifier; the full PAN is never exposed, and risk scores are computed without using raw card data.

Notify the release owner, security/PCI reviewers and affected stakeholders before and after rollback, then record the outcome; no database migration rollback is required because changes_db_schema is false.
